title: onprem/airgap: offline bundle vendor updates for rke2/k3s + ubuntu-22.04 TUF and vendoring improvements
author: Lucas Chen
description: Motivation: Customers running private/offline deployments on a variety of on-prem Kubernetes distributions (RKE2, k3s, and upstream k8s on Ubuntu 22.04) reported bundle installation failures and long vendor refresh times. This PR updates the offline bundle generation and vendoring tooling to: 1) include a dedicated Ubuntu 22.04 image set and updated apt/tuf metadata, 2) add RKE2 and k3s distro-specific manifests and validations, 3) shrink the default bundle by dropping unused debug assets and switching several images to multi-arch OCI indexes, and 4) harden TUF metadata verification on installer path and add checksum validation for all tarball artifacts. Changes: - offline-bundles/ubuntu-22.04: new image set and apt mirror manifest - vendor/scripts: faster image mirror + layered dedupe pass - installer/pkg/tuf: stricter validation and better error messages - installer/upgrade: fix rollback hook ordering for k3s/rke2-specific upgrades - helm-charts/redwood-private: chart tweaks to accept vendored imageRef overrides - terraform/modules/installer: expose bundle_checksum and tuf_root_version as module outputs Testing: - Local bundle generation + install on k3s (v1.26.x) and rke2 (v1.26.x) clusters - e2e smoke on air-gapped VM with simulated apt mirror - TUF validation fuzzing and negative test to ensure failures are fatal - Integration test in perf-canary using a smaller bundle to validate startup times Rollout notes: - This change is backward compatible with existing bundles (installer will detect tuf_root_version) but we recommend regenerating customer bundles to benefit from size and validation improvements. - For enterprise customers using Private with reserved support, we will coordinate bundle refresh; see linked Linear task ENG-2210. Checklist: - [x] Add Ubuntu 22.04 vendoring manifests - [x] Add rke2/k3s distro manifests and validators - [x] Add tuf metadata checks and checksum outputs - [x] Update helm chart image overrides - [x] Add terraform outputs for bundle metadata - [x] Add tests and CI coverage Known limitations: - Flatcar support unchanged in this PR (follow-up planned), - Bundle generation still takes ~12-18 minutes on CI runners; can be optimized further in ENG-2265.

changelog_entries: Added Ubuntu 22.04 offline bundle manifest and apt mirror support.
Added rke2 and k3s distro-specific manifests and validators.
Hardened TUF metadata verification and added artifact checksums.
Updated helm chart to support vendored imageRef overrides.
Exposed bundle metadata (bundle_checksum, tuf_root_version) in terraform module outputs.
Fixed rollback hook ordering during upgrades on rke2/k3s.
testing_instructions: Generate a bundle with scripts/generate-bundle.sh --distro rke2 --os ubuntu-22.04 then run installer/hack/verify-bundle.sh against a local airgapped registry. Run tests/airgap/smoke_test.sh on a k3s cluster and tests/airgap/negative_tuf_test.sh to ensure TUF failures are detected. For terraform: apply terraform/modules/installer with bundle_checksum output and verify installer detects tuf_root_version.
notes: Follow-up work: ENG-2265 to reduce bundle generation time and ENG-2290 to add Flatcar image set. Security: documented TUF root rotation procedure in security/tuf/README.md.
